objective.text: Keep a row lock inside the transaction that protects the corresponding write.

difficulty.rationale: Keep the lock lifetime, validation read and corresponding write in one transaction.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: PostgreSQL 18, READ COMMITTED, ordinary autocommit outside DB::transaction. Every competing stock writer follows the selected protocol.

stem: Stock must never become negative. A request reads stock, checks availability and decrements it. Which lock placement protects that read/check/write sequence against another buyer?

options.text: Inside one transaction, select the stock row with lockForUpdate, check it, then update before committing.
options.rationale: The row lock remains held through the check and write, serializing competing participants in this protocol.

options.text: Select with lockForUpdate in autocommit, then start a transaction for the check and update.
options.rationale: The locking statement’s transaction has ended before the protected work begins, so the lock no longer spans the sequence.
options.misconception: The locking statement’s transaction has ended before the protected work begins, so the lock no longer spans the sequence.

options.text: Read and check normally, update, then select with lockForUpdate before returning.
options.rationale: A lock acquired after the decision and write cannot retroactively protect the earlier stale read.
options.misconception: A lock acquired after the decision and write cannot retroactively protect the earlier stale read.

options.text: Lock only a separate audit row while all buyers read the stock row without a common lock.
options.rationale: Different audit rows do not serialize access to the shared stock invariant.
options.misconception: Different audit rows do not serialize access to the shared stock invariant.

validation.reason: Laravel requests a write row lock; PostgreSQL holds it until transaction end. Transaction placement and invariant reasoning are documented-contract validation, not a SQLite concurrency test.
